verdict.rationale: Channel3 is a product-data API. The evidence shows no built-in AI assistant users can hand tasks to. Its 'agentic mode' is an LLM-planned search option within the search endpoint, an adjacent feature rather than an assistant that takes on delegated tasks. The MCP server and UCP integration serve external agents, not an in-product assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
